spellbook.finance/limitations: A destination with status skipped has no net. Read skipReason and missingFields, and do not treat a skipped destination as zero.
Nets come from stored vendor prices and channel price inputs at observedAt, minus the fees the row states. They are estimates, not quotes, and reserve no copy.
The response names no best destination. The caller decides using its own policy.
A vendor minimum, a quantity cap or an unsupported finish can make a destination unusable for a group even when a net is shown for a smaller quantity.

annotations.title: Compare buylist and channel nets for inventory

description: Read one page of a workspace's sellable inventory, one group per printing, finish and condition, with the per-unit net at each of seven destinations: Card Kingdom cash, Card Kingdom credit, Star City Games cash, ManaPool, TCGplayer, TCGplayer Direct and eBay. Each destination carries gross, fees, net, price source, observation time, vendor minimum, quantity the vendor is buying and a skip reason when it has no usable price. Pass nextCursor back to read the next page. It lists every destination in a fixed order and does not rank them, name a best one or say what to sell.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Maximum groups to return, 1 to 500. Omit for the server default.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose inventory to compare, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_buylist_compare
